Message:
scsi: mpt3sas: Fix an issue when driver is being removed

Warnings may be logged during driver removal:

mpt3sas 0000:01:00.0: AMD-Vi: Event logged [IO_PAGE_FAULT ..,

Fix this by deallocating DMA memory later.
